{{Quote|Your father was an honorable and respected warrior, young Skywalker. Being able to turn the Jeedai legacy over to his son is more than I ever hoped.|[[Nei Rin]] to [[Cade Skywalker]]|<ref name="Legacy 12" />}}
[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kol Skywalker]] built his blue-bladed '''lightsaber''' prior to the failure of the [[Ossus Project]] in [[127 ABY]]. Kol wielded it in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]] against [[Darth Nihl]] and the rest of the [[One Sith|Sith strike force]] that [[Massacre at Ossus|attacked]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] in [[130 ABY]]. It was lost after Kol's [[Death/Legends|death]] and later discovered by [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Master Shaper]] [[Nei Rin]] amongst the ruins. Rin had replaced the original [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|focusing crystal]] with a [[lambent]] crystal of her own shaping after it was badly burnt in the battle against the Sith, thus the blue blade was replaced with a green blade.

Seven years later when Kol's son, [[Cade Skywalker]], discovered the [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Hidden Temple]], Nei Rin gifted him the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Cade carried the weapon with him during his [[Duel in the Temple of the Sith|mission]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to rescue [[Jedi healer/Legends|Jedi healer]] [[Hosk Trey'lis]] where it was temporarily seized and encased in a [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] case, by [[Darth Krayt]], to honor Cade's father.<ref name="Legacy15">[[Legacy (2006) 15|''Legacy'' (2006) 15]]</ref> Cade was able to recover the weapon before his [[Skirmish at the Temple of the Sith|escape]] and carried it with him in his [[Mission to Had Abbadon|battles]] [[Battle on Had Abbadon|with]] the [[Mission to Utapau (Second Imperial Civil War)|Sith]] up until the [[Battle of Coruscant (Second Imperial Civil War)|death]] of [[Darth Krayt]]. As of [[138 ABY]] it was still believed to be in his possession.
